findings.title: Remote endpoint does not validate the Origin header
findings.message: https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp accepted a request with Origin: http://evil.mcpdoctor.invalid (HTTP 200).
findings.fix: Reject requests whose Origin is not on an allow-list, and bind to 127.0.0.1 for local servers.

findings.title: No guidance on when to use (or not use) the tool
findings.message: 3 of 3 tools give no 'use when / do not use' guidance: ask_wiki_question, read_wiki_contents, read_wiki_structure.
findings.fix: Add a 'Use when...' / 'Do not use for...' sentence that separates the tool from its neighbours.

findings.title: Two tools overlap too closely
findings.message: Tools 'read_wiki_contents' and 'read_wiki_structure' have 45% overlapping descriptions and identical parameters.
findings.fix: Merge them, or make each description say what distinguishes it from the other.

findings.title: No behaviour annotations
findings.message: 3 of 3 tools have no read_only_hint/destructive_hint: ask_wiki_question, read_wiki_contents, read_wiki_structure.
findings.fix: Set read_only_hint and destructive_hint on every tool.

findings.title: Remote endpoint accepts unauthenticated requests
findings.message: https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp completed an MCP initialize request without any credentials (HTTP 200). All 3 tools look read-only, so open access may be intended for a public service. Add authentication if any of this data is private.
findings.fix: Require OAuth 2.1 / bearer tokens on the MCP endpoint.
